questions.questionText: The Louis de Broglie wavelength of a particle having kinetic energy E is :
If drift velocity of electron be v_d and intensity of electric field E, then which relation among the following obeys Ohm's law ?

Force of 80 Newton works between two point charges placed at a fixed distance apart in air. When these charges are placed at the same distance apart in a dielectric medium, then force of 8 Newton works on it. The dielectric constant of medium will be :
Find the ratio of focal length of lens in air and that of lens when it is immersed in liquid.
In hydrogen atom what is the ionization potential of electron in the ground state ?
Write the definition and dimensional formula of electrical conductivity.
Which value of current does the ammeter used in A.C. circuit measure ?
How much charge is there on hole ? Draw the circuit symbol of p-n junction diode.
Between radio waves and micro waves, which one has a higher frequency ?
Define the mass defect and binding energy of nucleus.
A double concave lens has to be made from crown glass. How much should the radii of surfaces of lens be kept to make the power of lens −2·5 D ? Refractive index of crown glass is 1·65.
Explain the operation of p-n junction diode in forward bias.
What is the effect on range and sensitivity of an ammeter when the value of its shunt resistance increases ?
If a thin prism of glass be immersed in water, then prove that the minimum deviation produced by prism becomes one-fourth with respect to air. Given ₐn_g = 3/2; ₐn_w = 4/3.
Discuss the significance of displacement current and find the phase difference between it and the conduction current.
Explain nuclear fission and nuclear fusion with examples.

A plastic ball P of mass 3·2 × 10⁻¹⁵ kg is suspended between two horizontal parallel charged plates in balanced state. How many electrons on the ball will be increased or decreased ? (g = 10 m/s²) (Figure: plates 2 cm apart, potential difference 1000 Volt, forces qE upward and mg downward on P.)
What are electromagnetic waves ? Draw their propagation diagram. Show the electric field amplitude and magnetic field amplitude in propagation diagram.
Define interference. Mention the condition for constructive and destructive interference.
The atomic mass of ₈O¹⁶ is 16·0000 amu. Calculate its binding energy per nucleon. Mass of electron 0·00055 amu, mass of proton 1·007593 amu and mass of neutron 1·008982 amu and 1 amu = 931 MeV.
Determine the nature of force acting between two parallel current carrying conductors when : (i) Current is in the same direction in conductors, (ii) Current is in opposite direction in conductors.

Energy of a particle at absolute temperature T is of order of kT. Calculate the wavelength of thermal neutrons at 27°C. Find the energy of photon having same wavelength. Here k is Boltzmann constant.
By drawing a ray diagram, explain the formation of image in a compound microscope. Establish the formula for magnifying power for it.

In a circuit, the equation for alternative voltage V is represented by V = 40 sin (100 πt) volt. Here t is in seconds. Draw the time – voltage (t – V) graph with proper scale for one cycle. Calculate the root mean square value of voltage.
What is atomic model of magnetism ? Differentiate between paramagnetic, diamagnetic and ferromagnetic substances on this basis. Also give one example of each.
